title: Second sightings link to a PART of their main record, not to the whole item; three item-level links become related-item notes; seven compound findings are split into the parts a batch can take separately (Codex's review of revision 2, C; Codex's corrections of the revision-3 plan, section 4).

schema.note: Item.canonical (an item id) is removed; Part.canonical ({ item, part }) is added; Item.related and Item.retiredParts are added. Nothing else in the record changes.

184.note: B89 (a card Square refused to save reads 'no card') and A68 (no permission on the order shows '—') are two defects in the same column, not one.

212.note: B116 (which anniversary the renewal date is) and A3 (how many days before it the notice goes out) are two questions about the renewal, not one.

258.note: B158 (the asset schedule's heading names the series in the agreement but not in the consent) and A50 ('Members' vs 'Member(s)'; four rows vs five) are different lines of the same exhibit.

split.scope: The unreachable "Submit" step and its dead page, whose sentence says the operating agreement is sent with the filed documents, are removed.
The progress percent counts only the steps a client can reach: one denominator, no hidden steps.

89.note: B51's sentence lives on the dead page A26 removes; it is not the progress percent.

split.scope: The consent document's title in the portal: "Consent & Series Exhibit — [series]".

259.note: B167 is the server line that sets the title A52 asks for; it says nothing about the button.

split.scope: The consent, questionnaire and amendment forms default their dates from Florida's date given by the server, not the device's UTC day.
The two dates rendered in the viewer's zone are formatted with formatDate.
The questionnaire seed carries todayEastern, so the questionnaire and amendment forms default from Florida's date.
`blocked: false` is written and read nowhere; dropped from the response and the type.

164.note: B138's date half is A60's device-clock default seen from the server; its `blocked: false` half is independent housekeeping.

split.scope: The EIN hint mentions Form 2553 only when a company EIN is being entered AND a matching S election package exists; a series EIN goes on no 2553.
The S election date row no longer says "entered by the client" after a correction.
The series text no longer says "once … uploaded" inside the dialog that does the uploading.
A typed EIN does not survive closing the dialog.

211.note: B114 is the server-side refusal text making the same 2553 promise as the dialog's hint; the other three parts of A75 are untouched by it.
